title_en: Ethical Diamond Aimed at Kentucky Downs Turf Cup
description: Burnham Square is scheduled to have some international competition when racing in the Sept. 5 Kentucky Downs Turf Cup Invitational Stakes (G2T). Irish-based 2025 Breeders' Cup Turf (G1T) upsetter Ethical Diamond is another intended starter.

title_en: Sprinkler System Puts Out Barn Fire at Delaware Park
description: Crisis was averted at Delaware Park in the late evening hours of Aug. 10 as a small barn fire was extinguished by a sprinkler system. No injuries to horses or humans were reported.

title_en: Foreman: HISA Provides Critical Returns on Safety, Labs
description: At the Racing and Gaming Conference at Saratoga, HISA independent ombudsman Alan Foreman notes important areas where the independent enforcement agency that launched fully in May 2023 has moved racing forward.

title_en: Kentucky Downs to Host 20 Stakes Worth $25.75M
description: The 2026 Kentucky Downs meet will feature 20 stakes races with $25.75 million in total purses. The seven-day racing season opens on Saturday, Aug. 29, and continues on Aug. 30, Sept. 3, Sept. 5-7, and Sept. 9, offering stakes action every date.

title_en: Keeneland Catalogs 4,635 Hips for Sept. Yearling Sale
description: Keeneland has cataloged 4,635 horses for the 83rd edition of its September Yearling Sale, which will cover 12 sessions from Monday, Sept. 14 through Saturday, Sept. 26. The catalog is now online.

title_en: Rail-Drawn Luster Bids for King's Plate Glory
description: When the CA$1 million King's Plate, the oldest continuously run horse race in North America, is renewed Aug. 15, the rail-drawn Luster will be heavily favored to become the 40th filly to win the 1 1/4-mile race for Canadian-bred 3-year-olds.

title_en: Sovereignty Reigns in Latest NTRA Top Thoroughbred Poll
description: Godolphin's Sovereignty is atop the National Thoroughbred Racing Association Top Thoroughbred Poll following his 4 3/4-length come-from-behind victory against a star-studded field in the Aug. 8 Whitney Stakes (G1) at Saratoga.

title_en: Miss Monica Tops Latest Maiden Watch Qualifiers
description: Miss Monica, Caribbean Life, and Embouteillage are the latest BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after first-out victories in recent days.

title_en: Vino Rosso, Yaupon Continue Rise Among Stallion Ranks
description: This edition of The List examines the changes to the top 25 over the last six weeks, with a trio of stallions trending in the right direction.

title_en: Hip 194 Catches Eye, Full Brother to Two-Time G1 Winner
description: After last year selling a trio of colts at Fasig-Tipton's The Saratoga Sale, two of which have already gone on to debut victories, Bridie Harrison, agent for breeder Peter E. Blum, is back at the select sale this year with four more promising colts.

title_en: Nyquist Dominates Day 1 at F-T Saratoga With $3.2M Colt
description: Building on a stellar 2026 racetrack campaign with six graded stakes winners, Nyquist extended his dominance to the sales ring during Day 1 of Fasig-Tipton's The Saratoga Sale Aug. 10. Hip 83 commanded $3.2 million from Boyd Racing.

title_en: F-T Saratoga Day 1 Sees $3.2M Nyquist Colt
description: Boyd Racing lands the Day 1 topper after going to $3.2 million for a bay son of Nyquist out of grade 2 winner Slammed at Fasig-Tipton's The Saratoga Sale.

title_en: Curlin Colt Sells Well Early, Fetching $2 Million
description: Bloodstock agent Donato Lanni, flanked by owner Amr Zedan and trainer Bob Baffert, nailed the first seven-figure yearling to sell at this year's Fasig-Tipton's The Saratoga Sale Aug. 10.

title_en: Nyquist Colt Out of Stakes-Rich Family Climbs to $3.2M
description: The strapping bay colt (Hip 83) by Nyquist rose quickly into seven-figure territory, with each early bid jumping by $100,000 increments. Soon the colt owned the top price of $3.2 million during the opening session of Fasig-Tipton's The Saratoga Sale.

title_en: Gun Runner, Into Mischief Colts Reach $2.3M at Saratoga
description: Hip 78 and 91 became the seventh and eighth seven-figure yearling colts in the opening session of Fasig-Tipton's The Saratoga Sale.

title_en: Mallory Consigns First Million-Dollar Yearling
description: Scott Mallory sold his first million-dollar yearling Aug. 10 when Hip 40, a Determined Stud-bred daughter of Candy Ride, sold for $1,075,000 to Legion Bloodstock and Gracie Bloodstock at Fasig-Tipton's The Saratoga Sale.

title_en: HISA Investigating Multiple Races at Monmouth, Saratoga
description: HISA plans to investigate multiple horses and races following concerns raised on social media about some dramatic form turnarounds along with some odd betting patterns in several races Aug. 9 at Saratoga Race Course and Monmouth Park.

title_en: IHA Gives Racing Protection Against Prediction Markets
description: As prediction market platforms continue to proliferate in the United States, a prominent expert on gaming law believes racing's pari-mutuel betting is better protected than those other forms of gaming.

title_en: Curlin Colt Sails to $2M Early in Saratoga Sale
description: The Curlin colt (Hip 19) consigned by Hill 'n' Dale at Xalapa is the first seven-figure purchase on opening day of Fasig-Tipton's The Saratoga Sale.

title_en: Tattersalls Releases Remaining October Sale Entries
description: Godolphin and the John and Thady Gosden stable's Ombudsman, who is set to chase his sixth group 1 victory in next week's International Stakes (G1), is the flagbearer among purchases from Book 2, for which this year's catalog was released Aug. 10.

title_en: Randazzo Jr. Trains 1,000th Winner
description: Veteran trainer Frank Randazzo Jr. reached a career milestone Aug. 8 when he saddled his 1,000th Thoroughbred winner, Mysweetanalyze, in the sixth race at at Fairmount Park.

title_en: Minnesota Festival of Champions Purses Increased by $5K
description: The Minnesota Breeders' Fund Thoroughbred Advisory Committee has authorized the addition of $5,000 MBF dollars to each of the six Thoroughbred Minnesota Festival of Champions stakes races Sept. 5.

title_en: BH Monday: Maryland Gov. Moore on Preakness Changes
description: On the Aug. 10 episode of BloodHorse Monday: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore discusses Preakness Stakes (G1) changes, Miguel Clement reflects on an emotional weekend, Par Avion LTD president Janine Iannarelli discusses international aircraft business.

title_en: F-T Flash Sale Offers 50% Interest in Silent Tactic
description: Bidding opened Aug. 10 for the Fasig-Tipton Digital Silent Tactic Flash Sale, offering a 50% ownership interest in graded stakes-winning 3-year-old colt Silent Tactic. Bidding will close Aug. 14. at 12 p.m. ET.

title_en: White Abarrio Retired From Racing
description: According to an Aug. 10 social media post on X from White Abarrio's co-owners, Clint and Mark Cornett of C2 Racing Stable, the 7-year-old son of Race Day has been retired from racing.

title_en: Holmby Outduels Ruiva in a Sorrento Stakes Thriller
description: Talla Racing's 2-year-old Holmby and Juan Hernandez won a fierce duel with the globetrotting Ruiva to take the 6-furlong, $150,500 Sorrento Stakes Aug. 9 at Del Mar.

title_en: Johnny V Avenges West Virginia Derby Second with Zihnal
description: After finishing second in the 2025 West Virginia Derby (G3), jockey John Velazquez returned Aug. 9 to Mountaineer Casino Racetrack & Resort with redemption on his mind.

title_en: Patience Pays as John the Beer Man Game in Troy Triumph
description: After missing nearly two years of racing, John the Beer Man is making a run at being considered one of the nation's top turf sprinters after winning a dramatic $300,000 Troy Stakes (G2T) Aug. 9 at Saratoga Race Course.

title_en: Samangan Lives Up to Graffard's Faith at Deauville
description: Samangan fulfilled all the hopes invested in him at the beginning of the year when holding the desperate late thrust of Division to land the Aug. 9 Prix Maurice de Gheest (G1) at Deauville.

title_en: Is Sun Goddess O'Brien's Top Filly After Phoenix Win?
description: Sun Goddess became the first Ballydoyle-based filly to win the Aug. 9 Phoenix Stakes (G1), justifying 5-4 favoritism without too much fuss.

title_en: Induction a First Winner for Pin Oak's Scalding
description: Dual grade 3 winner and freshman sire Scalding was represented by his first winner Aug. 9 when Induction won the fifth race at Colonial Downs.

title_en: Deterministic Likely Targeting Woodbine Mile
description: Notes from Saratoga Race Course.

title_en: Nitrogen a Winner in Whitney Defeat
description: Despite being defeated in the Whitney Stakes (G1) Aug. 8, Mark Casse found himself receiving plenty of congratulations Aug. 9 after the filly Nitrogen ran a strong second against the boys.

title_en: Sovereignty's Stardom Renewed After Whitney Win
description: The morning after winning the Whitney Stakes (G1), Hall of Fame trainer Bill Mott took a moment to reminisce about the love the Saratoga Race Course crowd showed Sovereignty Aug. 8.

title_en: Magnitude Likely to Train Up to Breeders' Cup Classic
description: Following disappointing runs in the Whitney Stakes (G1) Aug. 8, Magnitude will likely train up to the Breeders' Cup Classic (G1) while connections will debate White Abarrio's retirement.

title_en: Red-Hot Hernandez Gets Warming to Wire Just in Time
description: Juan Hernandez and Warming took the long way around and still prevailed in the Yellow Ribbon (G2T) at 1 1/16 miles on the Del Mar grass. Warming's winning margin was a neck, which gives the daughter of Global Campaign her second stakes score of 2026.

title_en: Family'spet First Winner for Freshman Sire Eight Rings
description: Family'spet became the first winner for freshman sire Eight Rings in capturing a maiden race at Wyoming Downs in front-running fashion by 3 3/4 lengths.

title_en: Brant Retired; Enters Stud at Hill 'n' Dale in 2027
description: 2025 Del Mar Futurity (G1) winner Brant has been retired from racing and will enter stud next year at Hill 'n' Dale at Xalapa.

title_en: 'Absolute Gift': Girvin Dies Suddenly at Airdrie Stud
description: Airdrie Stud reports that its fast-rising stallion Girvin, who won the 2017 Haskell Stakes (G1), died suddenly Aug. 8 at the farm near Midway, Ky. He was 12.

title_en: Group 1 Winner, Producer Immortal Verse Dies at 18
description: Coolmore Stud announced Aug. 7 that brilliant racemare and exceptional producer Immortal Verse has died at Coolmore America's Ashford Stud at the age of 18.

title_en: The Jockey Club Notes Efforts to Fill FanDuel TV Void
description: In case anyone failed to get the memo after many of the presentations at this year's edition of The Jockey Club Round Table focused on building fan interest, Everett Dobson hammered home the message in his closing remarks.

title_en: Thousand Words Sold to Duncan Farms in Ohio
description: Thousand Words was a $1 million sales yearling that went on to win graded stakes at 2 and 3. The third-crop sire by Pioneerof the Nile is out of multiple grade 1-placed, multiple graded stakes winner Pomeroys Pistol.

title_en: Round Table Speakers Offer Ideas on Building Connection
description: As a number of presenters talked about engaging new fans at the 2026 edition of The Jockey Club's Round Table on Matters Pertaining to Racing Aug. 6 in Saratoga Springs, N.Y., marketing expert Tor Edwards noted that young people are aware of racing.

title_en: Twinkle Town Brings Attention to Take Charge Indy
description: In this week's Porter on Pedigrees, Saratoga Special Stakes (G2) winner Twinkle Town shines a spotlight on WinStar Farm's repatriated sire Take Charge Indy.

title_en: Life Changing, Voyager Impress at Saratoga
description: A pair of nicely bred juvenile fillies in Life Changing and Voyager have been named BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects following their impressive victories in the past week at Saratoga Race Course.

title_en: PA Supreme Court Protects State Racinos, Horse Racing
description: Dollars & Sense with Frank Angst, presented by the NTRA, examines a recent Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruling that found games of skill operating in the state illegal. The decision figures to benefit Thoroughbred racing.

title_en: Litz Named Maryland Horse Breeders Executive Director
description: Anne Litz will start working with current executive director Cricket Goodall as her assistant, with the plan to succeed Goodall in July 2027.

title_en: Nysos Retired Healthy, to Stand at Ashford Stud
description: Nysos, winner of this year's Metropolitan Handicap (G1), has been retired from racing and will stand at Coolmore's Ashford Stud.

title_en: Cornerstone Stud Dispersing Entire Bloodstock Portfolio
description: Australia's Cornerstone Stud will hold a complete dispersal of its bloodstock through the Inglis Digital August (Early) Sale, which runs Aug. 7-12.

title_en: Kentucky Derby Runner Master Fencer Sires First Winner
